t-SNE on species level RPKMF values

## Load libraries

```{r}
library(tidyr)
library(Rtsne)
library(ggplot2)
```


## Load data

esviritu_human = human viruses detected from 2020-2021 & 2024-2025 samples with EsViritu
*_ANI90 = same df but with only detections with >= 90% average nucleotide identity

```{r}
esviritu_human <- fread(here("data", "Human_data.tsv"))

esviritu_human_ANI90 <- esviritu_human %>%
  filter(avg_read_identity >=0.90)
```

```{r}
sample_metadata <- read.csv(here("data", "samples_metadata.csv"), sep=";", dec=",")

sample_metadata$Year_cat <- ifelse(sample_metadata$Year == "2020" | 
                                     sample_metadata$Year == "2021", 
                                   "2020-2021", "2024-2025")
```


## t-SNE on RPKMF

```{r create-RPKMF-dataframe}
RPKMF_df <- function(data, tax_level){
  RPKMF_df <- data %>%
    group_by(sample_ID, !!sym(tax_level)) %>%
    summarize(RPKMF = sum(RPKMF)) %>%
    ungroup()
  
  RPKMF_df_wide <-pivot_wider(data=RPKMF_df,
                    names_from = sample_ID,
                    values_from = RPKMF,
                    values_fill = list(RPKMF=0))

  return(RPKMF_df_wide)
}
```


```{r tSNE-on-RPKMF}
tsne_RPKMF <- function(data, taxa_level, perplex, color_var){
  set.seed(2025)
  df <- RPKMF_df(data, taxa_level)
  df[1,1] <- NA
  
  df_wide <- t(df[,-1])
  colnames(df_wide) <- df[[taxa_level]]
  
  prcomp1 <- prcomp(log10(df_wide+1),scale. = TRUE)
  #return(prcomp1)
  var_exp <- round(prcomp1$sdev^2 / sum(prcomp1$sdev^2)*100,2)
  #return(var_exp)  #return this to calculate captured variance by PC
  
  #use only first 10 principal components in Rtse to reduce noise
  tsne <- Rtsne(prcomp1$x[,1:10], perplexity = perplex, pca=FALSE)
  tsne_val <- tsne$Y
  
  rownames(tsne_val) <- colnames(df)[-1]
  
  tsne_val_df <- as.data.frame(tsne_val)
  tsne_val_dt <- setDT(tsne_val_df, keep.rownames = "sample_ID")
  tsne_val_dt <- merge(tsne_val_dt, sample_metadata, by ="sample_ID")
  tsne_val_dt$color <- factor(tsne_val_dt[[color_var]])
  
  pal <- park_palette("DeathValley")[c(6,1)]

  ggplot(tsne_val_dt, aes(x=V1, y=V2, color=factor(tsne_val_dt[[color_var]]))) +
    geom_point(size = 3, alpha = 0.8) +
    scale_shape_manual(values=c(15, 16, 17, 18, 3, 4 ,8, 9, 11, 13)) +
    scale_color_manual(name = c("Year"), values = pal) +
    theme_bw() +
 theme(panel.grid.major = element_blank(), 
       panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        panel.background = element_blank())+
    
    labs(x=sprintf("tSNE-1"), 
         y=sprintf("tSNE-2"))
}
```

```{r}
fonts <- theme(text = element_text(family = "Arial", size=14),
    plot.title = element_text(family = "Arial", size=14, face = "bold", hjust=0.5, vjust=0.5))
```


```{r tsne-plots}
tsne_species_20PC <- tsne_RPKMF(esviritu_human, "species", 30, "Year_cat") +
  fonts
#ggsave(tsne_species_20PC, file= here("outputs/Figures/Virome_Community", 
#       "tsne_species_20PC.png"), width = 7.2, height = 4, units = "in", dpi=300)

tsne_genus <- tsne_RPKMF(esviritu_human, "genus", 30, "Year_cat")+
  fonts


tsne_order <- tsne_RPKMF(esviritu_human, "order", 30, "Year_cat")+
  fonts

tsne_family <- tsne_RPKMF(esviritu_human, "family", 30, "Year_cat")+
  fonts
```

## Closer look on PCA components

```{r}
PCA_RPKMF <- function(data, taxa_level){
  set.seed(2025)
  df <- RPKMF_df(data, taxa_level)
  df[1,1] <- NA
  
  df_wide <- t(df[,-1])
  colnames(df_wide) <- df[[taxa_level]]
  
  prcomp1 <- prcomp(log10(df_wide+1),scale. = TRUE)
  return(prcomp1)
  #var_exp <- round(prcomp1$sdev^2 / sum(prcomp1$sdev^2)*100,2)
  #return(var_exp) 
  
}
```

```{r}
df <- RPKMF_df(esviritu_human, "species")
df[1,1] <- NA
  
df_wide <- t(df[,-1])
colnames(df_wide) <- df[["species"]]
  
pca_species <- prcomp(log10(df_wide+1),scale. = TRUE)


point <- pca_species$x[,1:2]

explained_variance <- (pca_species$sdev^2) / sum(pca_species$sdev^2)

explained_variance[1:8] 
plot(explained_variance, xlab="PC index",
ylab="fraction of variance explained", 
main="Variance explained by principal component")

PC1_variance <- round(explained_variance[1]*100,2) 
PC2_variance <- round(explained_variance[2]*100,2) 
plot(point, col="red", main="PCA - human viruses, species level",
cex=1, xlab=sprintf("PC1 %s %%", PC1_variance), ylab=sprintf("PC2 %s %%",PC2_variance)) 
points(point[1:60,], col="blue", cex=1)

legend(legend=c("2020-2021", "2024-2025"),
fill=c("blue", "red"), 
x="bottomright", 
cex=0.8)
```
